subject: Deployment path arbitration & MAP — timelines to close
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iy@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Riley <sam.riley@medarc-health.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@medarc-health.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment path arbitration & MAP — next 6 weeks

Sam / Asha —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, we put together a focused Mutual Action Plan (attached) that lays out the evaluation gates and a proposed close timeline so you have visibility into how we can get from PoC to contract. Because data residency is a hard requirement for some of your workflows, the MAP includes parallel tracks for: Hosted (GDPR-compliant EU region), Dedicated (reserved capacity in our EU zone), and Private (VPC / on-prem integration).

Key asks from your side for the MAP kickoff:
- Confirm which deployment modes you absolutely need us to qualify in the PoC (pick up to 2).
- Any strict regs beyond GDPR (e.g., specific regional geofencing or national cloud requirements).
- Procurement timeline / PO window.

Proposed week-0: alignment call (30m) to lock acceptance criteria — I can schedule Tue or Wed next week. Attached: MedArc_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with milestones), SOC2_scope.pdf.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on the evaluation plan so we can pick a target close date.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedArc_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_scope.pdf (pdf)
From: Sam Riley <sam.riley@medarc-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iy@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medarc-health.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Deployment path arbitration & MAP — next 6 weeks

Karthik —

Thanks for the MAP. A couple of urgent clarifications before we lock dates:
1) Private/on-prem is a hard ask for our clinical dataset in the EU — we need either a VPC deployment in our tenant or a private on-prem option. Hosted in an EU region is acceptable for non-PHI test data only.
2) Security: our InfoSec needs confirmation that you support HSM-backed KMS and token-level audit logs for inference requests (we will share a questionnaire).
3) Procurement: we typically run a 60-day procurement window from SOW + redlines. Any chance you can accelerate contract delivery once redlines land?

Looping in procurement now. Please copy in your solutions/ops lead so we can discuss technical feasibility.

—Sam
Director, Platform Engineering | MedArc Health

Subject: Re: Deployment path arbitration & MAP — next 6 weeks

Sam — thanks, noted. Looping Marissa (Solutions Eng) and Priya (Customer Success) to confirm technical approach and acceptance criteria. Quick summary of the plan we propose for evaluation so procurement has clarity: 

Evaluation plan (condensed):
- Scope: two parallel tracks — (A) Dedicated EU (reserved GPU pool) to validate performance and production routing; (B) Private VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC with Redwood private control plane) to validate data residency and KMS/HSM integration. Hosted EU region will be used for lightweight integration tests only.
- Acceptance criteria (PoC):
  * Latency p50 < 200ms for typical 64-token completions under 10 QPS with continuous batching enabled.
  * Throughput sustained at 100 concurrent inference streams for 30m without KV cache misses > 2%.
  * Security: KMS-backed keys + HSM support for key wrapping; audit log retention 90 days (can extend as add-on).
  * Functional: model pinning and deterministic model variant fallbacks during scale tests.
- Deliverables & milestones (from MAP):
  1) Week 0 (Apr 18): Kickoff + finalize acceptance dataset and test harness.
  2) Week 1–2: Dedicated PoC deploy and smoke tests.
  3) Week 3: Private VPC deploy (networking + KMS proof-of-concept).
  4) Week 4: Performance run & joint sign-off; remediate any gating issues.
  5) Contract close target: May 30 (to fit procurement window).

We attached an updated MAP (MedArc_MAP_v3.xlsx) and SOC2_scope.pdf with the exact audit artifacts we will surface. Marissa — can you add a brief technical test plan (networking checklist + example load profile) and confirm the HSM/KMS workflow? Priya — can you confirm CS handoff timing if we hit acceptance within 5 weeks?

Karthik

Attachments: MedArc_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOC2_scope.pdf
From: procurement@medarc-health.com
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iy@redwood.ai>, Sam Riley <sam.riley@medarc-health.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Apr 2027 14:40:00 +0100
Subject: MedArc procurement timelines / redlines

Karthik / Sam —

Procurement here. We reviewed the MAP and have uploaded initial contract redlines (attached: redlines-20270412.pdf). To summarize:
- We require a 60-day procurement window after SOW + vendor redline resolution.
- Standard data processing addendum (DPA) acceptance is required before any production trial with PHI data.
- Please provide a target SOW by Apr 20 so we can route internally.

We are open to an accelerated review if you can provide a clean SOW and answers to the redline items by Apr 18.

Thanks,
MedArc Procurement

Attachments: redlines-20270412.pdf

Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment path arbitration & MAP — next 6 weeks (technical test plan + schedule)

Sam / team —

Quick technical notes and a proposed execution cadence from the solutions side:

Feasibility summary:
- Private/VPC: We can run a Redwood private control plane that connects to customer-managed VPCs in the EU. HSM-backed KMS for key wrapping is supported via our KMS integration (we will provide integration docs and a short test script).
- Dedicated: We recommend an initial Dedicated SKU with 4x A10G-equivalent GPUs (optimized for batching) for the throughput targets you listed; we’ll tune sequence length and KV caching to hit the p50 latency target.

Proposed technical test plan (short):
1) Week of Apr 18: Network preflight + test key provisioning (HSM/KMS smoke).
2) Week of Apr 25: Dedicated deploy and controlled load tests (baseline metrics captured).
3) Week of May 2: Private VPC deployment and integration validation (audit log verification).
4) May 9–13: Final performance run and joint sign-off.

If procurement can provide a clean SOW by Apr 20, Redwood can expedite contract draft and aim for May 30 close. If procurement needs full 60 days, we can still run the PoC in parallel, but we will restrict PHI-associated tests to the Private track until the DPA is signed.

I’ll drop a short checklist to the Drive link and can run a 30-minute tech deep dive on Apr 19 (UTC-friendly time options below).

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
